message.text: I should look through the repository to locate MemoService.
I should check connect_services.go and v1.go to see how the registration is set up.
Now I want to locate RegisterConnectHandlers to check how the memo service registers its connect handler.

I'm noticing both gRPC-Gateway and Connect handlers registered for MemoService, so I want to check whether there's also a plain native gRPC server registration using RegisterMemoServiceServer rather than the HandlerServer variant.

I don't see native gRPC registration, only gRPC-Gateway for REST and Connect, which also handles gRPC and gRPC-Web. I want to double-check there isn't a separate grpc.Server setup elsewhere in the codebase before concluding.

Confirmed — there is no separate native `grpc.NewServer` registration in the app; only the gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON) and Connect registrations are actually wired up.

q19.
`MemoService` is served over two protocols:

1. **gRPC-Gateway (REST/HTTP+JSON)** — registered via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (line 108, inside `RegisterGateway`).
2. **Connect (Connect RPC, which also serves gRPC/gRPC-Web over the same handler)** — wired via `wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...))` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (line 40, inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`), with the handler's per-method wrapping/delegation implemented in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (the `// MemoService` section, lines 304–464).

Both registrations are invoked together from `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.
